rules.delta_convention: positive means challenger is better; regret delta = baseline regret - challenger regret
rules.paired_unit: dimension × panel × seed × relation_or_control × shell × method × baseline
rules.bootstrap: descriptive percentile CI and win rate over seed-cluster units; never candidate rows
rules.positive_rule: for one head, at least 2/3 positive shells pass at least 2/3 metrics; each metric requires seed-level win rate >= 0.5 against minimum_delta=0 and seed mean delta > minimum_delta; at least 2 metrics pass overall
rules.head_increment_rule: challenger has Rank-beyond increment iff at least 2/3 decision-metric seed means > minimum_delta=0 with seed win rate >= 0.5 AND at least 2/3 shells have at least 2/3 such metrics
rules.head_increment_source: raw results.csv, explicitly paired value-vs-rank and dual-vs-rank on every dimension × panel × seed × positive relation × shell
rules.identity_rule: after shell rows are averaged within seed, identity observed−permuted must have mean > minimum_delta=0 and seed win rate >= 0.5 for at least 2/3 metrics; report descriptive seed bootstrap CI
rules.negative_rule: for each negative condition, average shell rows within seed; a metric replicates only when mean > minimum_delta=0 and seed win rate >= 0.5; a condition replicates at least 2/3 metrics, and the overall negative rule fails when at least 2/3 (2 of 3) conditions replicate
rules.shell_rule: benefit cannot be confined to shell .35; at least 2 of 3 shells must pass
rules.selection_rule: Rank must pass first. For eligible value/dual challengers, compare metrics_passed, shells_passed, then the tuple of seed-level mean deltas in DECISION_METRICS order, then pair wins in DECISION_METRICS order; on an exact tie explicitly prefer value. Never sum or mix metric values.
rules.srmse_role: secondary only; never used for decision
